question: If any person is affected by a bee-sting attack, which chemical would be helpful for him to get some relief from pain?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Baking soda**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Baking soda** is effective in neutralizing the acidic venom injected by a bee sting.
 
• Applying a paste made of baking soda and water to the affected area can help reduce pain and swelling.
